text:
ITEM 1 | Bright orange-red shredded leafy mass with pale white-green stem edges, moist and glossy with slight sheen, limp soft strands folded in a loose heap covering roughly 12 percent of the plate, about 9 cm by 7 cm, piled roughly 2 to 3 cm high, sitting at the center-right of the plate | 85
ITEM 2 | Dark grey-green and brown charred piece with blackened grilled patches and a light tan cooked edge, firm-looking with slight sheen, flat irregular slab about 6 cm by 4 cm and roughly 1.5 cm thick, lying against the right side of the kimchi-like pile | 70
ITEM 3 | Thin bright green strip with darker green edge and pale flesh, slightly glossy, curved sliver about 4 cm long and 1 cm wide, lying under the edge of the red pile and next to the grilled piece | 8
ITEM 4 | Small whole cherry-type tomato, glossy orange-yellow skin with darker red-orange blush and slight wrinkling, intact and roughly 2.5 cm in diameter, sitting at the bottom edge of the red pile | 12
ITEM 5 | Small pale yellow-green fragment, soft and slightly glossy, about 2 cm long, lying at the top-left edge of the red pile | 2
ITEM 6 | Scattered tiny brown crumbs and specks, dry-looking with matte finish, each under 0.5 cm, a few dispersed near the left of the pile and on the plate surface | 1
